GO-2026-5932 is scoped exclusively to the golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package and its subpackages (openpgp, openpgp/packet, openpgp/armor, openpgp/clearsign, openpgp/errors, openpgp/elgamal, openpgp/s2k), which are unmaintained with no fixed version. Neither prometheus nor promtool imports any openpgp subpackage: go list -deps ./cmd/prometheus and ./cmd/promtool at v3.5.5 and v3.13.2 (x/crypto 0.55.0) resolve only cryptobyte, chacha20poly1305, bcrypt, blowfish, pkcs12, and hkdf from golang.org/x/crypto. Go dead-code elimination means the vulnerable openpgp code is not compiled into the shipped binaries. Scout matches at the module level because the advisory records golang.org/x/crypto with no fixed version.

GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28 (CVE-2026-44903) was fixed in the 3.5.x LTS line in v3.5.3. This image builds from upstream v3.5.5 (Go module v0.305.5), which includes escapeHTML for le label values in the legacy heatmap tick labels. The advisory scope is limited to the legacy web UI enabled with --enable-feature=old-ui; this image does not pass that flag. Scout matches because the advisory records a single Go-module fixed version of 0.311.3 rather than the LTS backport.

GHSA-vffh-x6r8-xx99 (CVE-2026-40179) was fixed in the 3.5.x LTS line in v3.5.2. This image builds from upstream v3.5.5 (Go module v0.305.5) and compiles the patched web UI where metric names and label values are escaped before innerHTML insertion. Scout matches because the advisory records a single Go-module fixed version of 0.311.2-0.20260410083055-07c6232d159b rather than the LTS backport.

GHSA-8rm2-7qqf-34qm (CVE-2026-42154) is a DoS on the /api/v1/read endpoint via an unvalidated snappy-decoded length. The fix was backported to the 3.5.x LTS line in v3.5.2 (Go module v0.305.2) and shipped for the 3.x line in v3.11.3 (Go module v0.311.3); the shipped v3.5.5 (Go module v0.305.5) compiles the patched code that validates the declared length before allocating. Scout flags the whole 0.305.x range because the advisory records a single 3.x fixed version of 0.311.3, so matches against the patched 3.5.x builds are false positives.
